title: maxfwd Module
content_markdown: The module implements all the operations regarding MaX-Forward header field, like adding it (if not present) or decrementing and checking the value of the existent one.
overview: The module implements all the operations regarding MaX-Forward header field, like adding it (if not present) or decrementing and checking the value of the existent one.

exported_parameters.name: max_limit
exported_parameters.description: Set an upper limit for the max-forward value in the outgoing requests. If the header is present, the decremented value is not allowed to exceed this max\_limits - if it does, the header value will by decreased to “max\_limit”.
exported_parameters.notes: Note: This check is done when calling the mf\_process\_maxfwd\_header() header.

exported_functions.name: mf_process_maxfwd_header

parameters.name: max_value
parameters.description: Value to be added if there is no Max-Forwards header field in the message.

return_values.condition: header was not found and a new header was successfully added
header was found and its value was successfully decremented (had a non-0 value)
the header was found and its value is 0 (cannot be decremented)

exported_functions.description: If no Max-Forward header is present in the received request, a header will be added having the original value equal with “max_value”. If a Max-Forward header is already present, its value will be decremented (if not 0).

exported_functions.name: is_maxfwd_lt

parameters.name: max_value
parameters.description: value to check the Max-Forward.value against (as less than).

return_values.condition: header was found or set and its value is strictly less than “max_value”
the header was found or set and its value is greater or equal to “max_value”
header was not found or not set

exported_functions.description: Checks if the Max-Forward header value is less then the “max_value” parameter value. It considers also the value of the new inserted header (if locally added).
